action: If Uber notifies you, follow its instructions, consider a fraud alert or credit freeze because licence numbers were taken, and be wary of messages asking you to confirm personal details.
exec: A supplier breach exposed identity data for about 150,000 people, bringing notification duties and fraud risk.
plain: Names, addresses and driver's licence details of about 149,000 people were stolen from Uber through Fireworks AI, an outside company that provides services to it.
summary: Uber is notifying 149,346 people (per its Oregon filing) after attackers used stolen internal credentials of Fireworks AI, a service provider, to reach Uber data there on October 7. Uber was told on October 9. Data includes names, addresses, dates of birth, licence numbers and images of driver's licences. Security Affairs, citing Uber's California filing and TechCrunch, names Fireworks AI.
title: Uber data breach affects 150,000 people through a third-party provider

validation.note: SecurityWeek and Security Affairs read; Security Affairs cites Uber's California AG filing and an Oregon filing (149,346) and TechCrunch for the Fireworks AI link and failed alerts. State filings themselves not read.
